notes: Technical report (not a system card). Safety evals are MultiJail (Table 7 summary + Table 26 per-language safe/invalid) and English XSTest over/under-refusal (Table 7). Figure 8 merging-safety chart has no extractable numbers. Skipped all capability benches (mDolly, mArenaHard, GlobalMGSM, Flores, WMT24++, GlobalMMLU, INCLUDE, GlobalPIQA, NormAd, BLEnD, language confusion). Internal Cohere multilingual safety benchmark mentioned without scores. Preprint date March 13, 2026 is not treated as model releaseDate. License not stated. Seed links only CohereLabs/tiny-aya-global; Earth/Fire/Water use rawModelName. Gemma3-4B and Ministral-3-3B left as rawModelName because the report does not name the Instruct seed variants. Swahili 7%/37% unsafe rates span a page break so put in findings rather than evalResults.
